summary: A groovebox firmware built on SLOOP 2.8 that adds a fourth synth part, a second drum track and multitrack USB recording, for four synths and two drum kits at once. Marked beta.
features: Six tracks: three synths, a lighter fourth synth part, two drum kits
MUUG engine: three-oscillator Moog-style synth with 100 presets, 24 dB ladder filter
8-channel USB audio: stereo master plus each track separately
Keeps SLOOP's 64-step sequencer, song mode, punch-in effects and samples
Same MIDI map as SLOOP, plus channel 11 for the second drum track
Spanish-first docs with an English manual; no way back to V15 in its installer
